name: Mimi's Cafe
notes: All 3 photos were legible printed menu pages (breakfast/brunch page, lunch+dinner entrees/desserts page, appetizers/entrees/sweet finish page); skipped cocktail list, add-ons, sides, and take-home muffin retail packs as modifiers/non-dish items.

dishes.name: Pain Perdu with Mixed Berries
dishes.description: Stuffed brioche french toast filled with orange marmalade and cream cheese blend, then topped with fresh berries and strawberry purée.

dishes.name: Malted Waffles
dishes.description: Buttermilk-malt waffles with whipped margarine and maple syrup.

dishes.name: Brioche French Toast
dishes.description: French toast dusted with powdered sugar with whipped margarine and maple syrup.

dishes.name: Cinnamon Roll French Toast
dishes.description: Cinnamon roll french toast with powdered sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.

dishes.name: Buttermilk Griddlecakes
dishes.description: Four buttermilk griddlecakes with whipped margarine and maple syrup.

dishes.name: Quiche Lorraine
dishes.description: Housemade with hickory-smoked bacon, green onion, mozzarella, and aged parmesan. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Quiche Florentine
dishes.description: Housemade with baby spinach, tomato, mozzarella, and aged parmesan. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Ham & Swiss Crêpes
dishes.description: Thick-cut ham and melted swiss cheese topped with a creamy mornay cheese sauce. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Breakfast Crêpes
dishes.description: Egg, spinach, tomato, and onion filling topped with creamy mornay cheese sauce. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Mixed Berry Crêpes
dishes.description: Filled with sweet orange marmalade cream cheese, topped with fresh strawberries & blueberries, and drizzled with strawberry purée. Served with two eggs any style and choice of sausage, bacon, or ham.

dishes.name: Fried Chicken & Waffles
dishes.description: Crispy hand-breaded chicken and two malted waffles with maple syrup.

dishes.name: Steak & Eggs
dishes.description: 28-day aged 10 oz. USDA Choice New York Strip. Housemade herb butter available upon request. Served with roasted potatoes and two eggs.

dishes.name: Farmhouse Breakfast Tacos
dishes.description: Hickory-smoked bacon, sausage, scrambled eggs, roasted potatoes, cheddar cheese, jalapeño, tomato, onion and cilantro in flour tortillas. Served with salsa.

dishes.name: Breakfast Burrito
dishes.description: Flour tortilla stuffed with braised beef, melted jack and cheddar cheese, scrambled eggs, avocado, tomato, jalapeño, green onion and cilantro. Topped with spicy chipotle sauce and served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Savory Breakfast Bowl
dishes.description: Two poached eggs, avocado, garlic-sautéed spinach and grape tomatoes on a bed of brown rice and quinoa blend, drizzled with olive oil.

dishes.name: Eggs & Bacon Croissant Sandwich
dishes.description: Bacon, two fried eggs, sliced tomatoes, melted cheddar and mayonnaise on a flaky croissant. Served with sliced tomatoes.

dishes.name: Brown Sugar Oatmeal
dishes.description: Rolled oats sprinkled with brown sugar and cranberries, served with milk.

dishes.name: Florentine Benedict
dishes.description: Bacon, poached eggs, spinach and sliced tomatoes topped with hollandaise sauce on a grilled english muffin.

dishes.name: Classic Benedict
dishes.description: Hickory-smoked ham and poached eggs topped with hollandaise sauce on a grilled english muffin.

dishes.name: Corned Beef Hash Benedict
dishes.description: Slow-cooked corned beef brisket and poached eggs, topped with hollandaise sauce on a grilled english muffin.

dishes.name: Smoked Salmon Benedict
dishes.description: Cold-smoked Atlantic salmon and poached eggs, topped with hollandaise sauce, diced red onions and capers on a grilled english muffin.

dishes.name: Santa Fe Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, diced jalapenos, cilantro, tomatoes, onions, tortilla strips, melted monterey jack cheese and chipotle sauce. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Bacon Avocado Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, hickory-smoked bacon, spinach, tomatoes, monterey jack cheese and avocado. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Egg White & Veggie Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, spinach, tomatoes, mushrooms, caramelized onions and crumbled feta cheese. Served with sliced tomatoes.

dishes.name: Bacon, Ham & Sausage Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, hickory-smoked bacon, ham, pork sausage, andouille sausage, tomato and melted cheddar cheese. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Smoked Salmon Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, cold smoked Atlantic salmon, diced red onions, capers and sour cream sauce. Served with roasted potatoes.

dishes.name: Bacon, Mushroom & Brie Omelet
dishes.description: Three eggs, roasted mushrooms, hickory-smoked bacon, caramelized onion, sautéed spinach and melted brie. Served with roasted breakfast potatoes.

dishes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
dishes.description: Freshly baked with roasted chicken, peas, carrots, onions and potatoes folded into a creamy herb sauce. Topped with a flaky crust.

dishes.name: Roasted Half Chicken
dishes.description: Slow-roasted with housemade herb butter. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Parmesan Crusted Chicken Pasta
dishes.description: Crispy hand breaded parmesan chicken breast with melted mozzarella and marinara sauce over linguine.

dishes.name: Slow-Roasted Turkey
dishes.description: Slow-roasted turkey with gravy, cornbread stuffing and orange-apple cranberry relish. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
dishes.description: Boneless skinless chicken breast wrapped around thinly sliced ham and Swiss cheese, breaded and served crispy with a Dijon mustard sauce. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Ribeye Steak
dishes.description: 28-day aged, 10 oz. USDA Choice ribeye steak. Housemade herb butter available upon request, your choice blackened or grilled. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Crab, Shrimp & Bacon Pasta
dishes.description: Lump blue crab, shrimp, bacon, onions and red fresno chili tossed with linguine and wine cream sauce, topped with parmesan cheese and served with garlic toast.

dishes.name: Jambalaya
dishes.description: Shrimp, chicken and andouille sausage, bell peppers and onions in a spicy tomato sauce. Served over your choice of penne pasta or long grain rice.

dishes.name: Chicken Cheddar Mac
dishes.description: Roasted chicken, crumbled bacon with penne in a rich cheddar sauce baked under a parmesan crust.

dishes.name: French Pot Roast
dishes.description: Slowly braised and simmered with carrots, mushrooms and onions. Served on a bed of mashed potatoes.

dishes.name: Mimi's Meatloaf
dishes.description: Our own traditional recipe topped with a red wine shallot sauce. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Beer Battered Fish & Chips
dishes.description: Hand-battered cod fillets with french fries, coleslaw and tartar sauce.

dishes.name: Hibachi Salmon
dishes.description: Grilled and topped with a sweet honey glaze. Served with sautéed vegetables and long grain rice.

dishes.name: Grilled Atlantic Salmon
dishes.description: Blackened or grilled. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: New York Strip Steak
dishes.description: 10 oz. USDA Choice New York Strip dry-aged 28 days, blackened or grilled. Housemade herb butter available upon request. Served with choice of two sides.

dishes.name: Bread Pudding
dishes.description: Made from scratch bread pudding with raisins, topped with whiskey sauce and whipped cream.

dishes.name: Molten Lava Cake
dishes.description: Warm molten chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream and a strawberry.

dishes.name: Butter Toffee Cake
dishes.description: Delicate sponge cake topped with sweet toffee sauce. Served with vanilla ice cream and whipped cream.

dishes.name: Apple Crisp Crumble
dishes.description: Warm apple filling in our flaky pastry pie crust, topped with cinnamon-sugar streusel and served with vanilla ice cream and caramel sauce.

dishes.name: Crème Brûlée
dishes.description: A decadent and creamy custard topped with caramelized sugar.

dishes.name: Classic Tiramisu
dishes.description: Layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and rich mascarpone cream, dusted with cocoa powder.

dishes.name: Crispy Arancini
dishes.description: Creamy risotto balls stuffed with cheese, breaded with panko breadcrumbs and gently fried. Served with basil marinara sauce.

dishes.name: Tempura Cauliflower
dishes.description: Lightly battered cauliflower and Asian slaw topped with sesame seeds and green onions, with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

dishes.name: Balsamic Glazed Spinach and Berry Salad
dishes.description: Fresh strawberries and blueberries tossed with baby spinach, quinoa blend and raspberry vinaigrette. Topped with balsamic glaze and housemade maple granola.

dishes.name: Mushroom & Brie Quiche
dishes.description: Roasted mushroom, brie cheese and caramelized onion quiche in a flaky shell, served with a house salad.

dishes.name: Crispy Chicken with Chardonnay Sauce
dishes.description: Crispy seared boneless chicken quarter, served with chardonnay thyme sauce, white wine risotto and french green beans.

dishes.name: Boneless Braised Short Rib
dishes.description: Red wine braised short ribs on a bed of mashed potatoes, topped with fresh onion crisps. Served with french green beans. Available starting in November.

dishes.name: Pumpkin Spice Sundae
dishes.description: Freshly baked Pumpkin Spice Muffin topped with vanilla ice cream, caramel sauce and whipped cream.

dishes.name: Cinnamon Apple Crêpes
dishes.description: Housemade crêpes filled with slow-cooked sliced apples, topped with powdered sugar, caramel sauce and vanilla ice cream.
